description: Definition of a policy category in the registry. Policy categories group related regulatory regimes (e.g., 'children_directed' groups COPPA, UK AADC, GDPR Article 8). Used on campaign plans (plan.policy_categories), signal definitions (signal-definition.policy_categories), and policy entries (policy-entry.policy_categories) to connect campaigns and data to the right regulatory frameworks.

category_id.description: Unique identifier for this category. Used in plan.policy_categories, signal-definition.policy_categories, and policy-entry.policy_categories.

description.description: What this category covers. Defines the boundary — what campaigns or data fall under this category.

facets.description: Registry-defined distinctions within the category that materially affect policy applicability or seller acceptance. Facets refine a category without creating a new top-level policy category.

guidance.description: Implementation notes for governance agents. Edge cases, disambiguation, and common pitfalls.

industries.description: Industries where this category commonly applies (e.g., 'pharmaceutical' for age_restricted). Governance agents MAY suggest relevant categories when a plan's brand industry matches but no policy_categories are declared.

regulatory_frameworks.description: Key regulations and standards grouped under this category. Governance agents use this to resolve specific policies from the registry.

jurisdictions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes where this framework applies.

name.description: Name of the regulation or standard (e.g., 'US COPPA').

policy_ids.description: Registry policy IDs that implement this framework.

summary.description: Brief summary of what the framework requires or prohibits.

related_categories.description: Categories that frequently co-occur (e.g., 'children_directed' often appears with 'age_restricted').

requires_human_review.description: When true, any plan declaring this category MUST set plan.human_review_required = true. Use for regulatory regimes that mandate human oversight under GDPR Art 22 or EU AI Act Annex III — fair_housing, fair_lending, fair_employment, pharmaceutical_advertising, and similar high-risk categories. Category-level setting applies to all policies and plans referencing it; policies can override on policy-entry.requires_human_review. Effective immediately regardless of individual policy `effective_date` fields.

restricted_attributes.description: Restricted attribute categories that regulations in this category prohibit for targeting. Governance agents enforce these when the category is active on a plan — if a plan declares policy_categories: ['fair_housing'], the governance agent restricts targeting on these attributes.

title: Policy Category Definition
